derivation: apparently a shortened form of H369 (אַיִן); but (like H370 (אַיִן)) an interrogative;

occurrences.text: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under thine hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.
